## [3 Legged Thing unveils three QD L-brackets](https://camerajabber.com/photography-news/3-legged-thing-unveils-three-qd-l-brackets/)
*Camera Jabber* | 11/06/2026 | Score: 0.70
Tags: photography, camera

> 3 Legged Thing has launched three new dedicated L-brackets for mirrorless cameras, with Oscar QD, Paige QD and Zayne QD covering selected OM System, Panasonic Lumix and Nikon bodies. The idea is simple, but useful: each bracket is shaped for a specific camera body, rather than relying on a universal fit. That means photographers can switch between landscape and portrait orientation on a tripod while keeping the camera better balanced over the head, without blocking the battery door, ports or rear screen movement where the host camera design allows it. As we found in our 3 Legged Thing Arnie L-bracket review, a well-made dedicated bracket can make tripod work feel more secure while maintaining access to the camera’s key doors and ports.
